description: Compatibility catalog, the NES mappers left after P0 (13, 47, 118): one case per catalog title, played past its title screen. The ROMs are the user's library (X:), not in the repo: the cases skip on a machine without it.

cases.description: Mapper 13. CPROM: 16KB CHR-RAM, $1000-$1FFF page switched, bus conflicts. Played past the title (Start presses), FIX/FIX/FIX. Golden recorded from the build that added the mapper; the picture was cross-checked against Mesen 2.1.1 with BrokenDev/tools/diff-nes.ps1 (2026-11-15): same final frame, the differing frames are one- to four-frame input-latency skews.

Mapper 47. NES-QJ: MMC3 + $6000 outer-block latch; block 0 (Super Spike V'Ball). Played past the title (Start presses), FIX/FIX/FIX. Golden recorded from the build that added the mapper; the picture was cross-checked against Mesen 2.1.1 with BrokenDev/tools/diff-nes.ps1 (2026-11-15): same final frame, the differing frames are one- to four-frame input-latency skews.
